proposals.why_missed: V22-V28 framed the bounded scalar as a treatment-response signal, but never tested whether responders simply have higher baseline APC/HLA-II module expression independent of dynamics. The deep-structure V26 axis is recurrent across cross-disease cell-states, suggesting it could be a baseline trait, not a treatment-induced trajectory.
proposals.expected_direction: If baseline-only APC/HLA-II module score discriminates responders vs nonresponders with AUC comparable to the locked dynamic scalar (within 0.10), the dynamic framing is partly redundant.
proposals.falsification_test: Recompute per-subject baseline (pre-treatment) APC/HLA-II module score on GSE235357 + GSE253006_TOF_exact, compute AUC for response, and compare to bounded V22 dynamic AUC 0.811 via DeLong or paired bootstrap. Falsifies dynamic-uniqueness if baseline AUC >= 0.75 with overlapping CI.

proposals.why_missed: V28 cohort fixed-effect adjustment treats cohort as a single label but does not adjust for within-cohort sex/age composition, which differs sharply between MS-DMF and UC-tofacitinib populations and is known to modulate HLA-II expression.
data_artifacts: data/raw (GSE235357, GSE253006 sample metadata if present)
proposals.expected_direction: If sex+age explain a substantial fraction of locked-score variance, cohort-adjusted coefficient 0.322 should attenuate by >40% when sex+age covariates are added.
proposals.falsification_test: Extract sex/age from GEO SOFT/series matrices for GSE235357 and GSE253006; refit linear probability model with cohort + sex + age. Falsifies bounded signal robustness if locked-score coefficient drops below nominal significance (robust p > 0.05) or attenuates >50%.

proposals.why_missed: APC/HLA-II module activity covaries with myeloid abundance and cycling cells. Prior V22-V28 work tested receptor-only as a control but did not test whether crude monocyte/DC fraction or proliferation signature alone reproduces the AUC.
data_artifacts: exact rescoring artifacts referenced in V23
proposals.expected_direction: If cell-composition or MKI67/TOP2A proliferation score reproduces AUC >= 0.75 in bounded set, the locked rule may be a composition proxy.
proposals.falsification_test: Compute per-sample monocyte fraction (or canonical proliferation signature) from same input matrices, evaluate AUC, and partial out from V22 scalar via residualized logistic regression. Falsifies APC-specificity if residualized V22 AUC drops below 0.65.

proposals.why_missed: V21 LDSC gave only genome-wide rg, not whether the APC/HLA-II module genes are heritability-enriched for MS/UC. The recurrent V26 axis was treated as transcriptomic without genetic anchoring.
proposals.expected_direction: If the V22 APC/HLA-II gene set shows partitioned-h2 enrichment >2x with FDR<0.05 in MS and UC, the axis gains genetic grounding; null result would caution against over-interpreting the transcriptomic axis.
proposals.falsification_test: Run LDSC partitioned heritability with a custom annotation built from the V22 module gene list (+/-100kb windows) against MS and UC sumstats already used in V13/V14. Falsifies genetic-anchoring claim if enrichment <=1 or p>0.1.

proposals.why_missed: DMF and tofacitinib both reduce circulating lymphocytes and modulate IFN; the locked scalar may be capturing a generic immunosuppression/infection-clearance transcriptional shift rather than disease-specific monitoring.
proposals.expected_direction: If a canonical glucocorticoid-response or generic type-I IFN-suppression signature (e.g., FKBP5, TSC22D3 / ISG15, IFI6) gives AUC comparable to V22 in the bounded set, mechanism specificity collapses.
proposals.falsification_test: Score canonical glucocorticoid and IFN-suppression gene sets per subject in GSE235357 and GSE253006_TOF_exact; compute AUC and Spearman with V22 scalar. Falsifies APC/HLA-II uniqueness if either set yields AUC>=0.78 and rho>0.7 with V22.

vulnerabilities.claim: The bounded V22 APC/HLA-II scalar is a mechanism-specific early treatment-response monitoring signal for immune-remodeling/JAK-STAT contexts.
vulnerabilities.weakness: The 'mechanism-specific' bounding is post-hoc: the rule failed in fingolimod and adalimumab and was retroactively excluded by mechanism class. With only 2 passing cohorts (n=19 total), the boundary is indistinguishable from selection on the dependent variable.
vulnerabilities.concrete_test: Pre-register the mechanism-specificity rule on a held-out JAK-STAT or Nrf2-modulating cohort before unblinding. In absence of new data, run a leave-one-cohort-out re-derivation: does each individual cohort, when held out, get re-included by the same a priori mechanism rule, or does the rule require knowledge of its outcome?
vulnerabilities.falsifies_if: If the mechanism rule, applied without outcome knowledge, would have included GSE250453 fingolimod (also immune-trafficking/lymphocyte-modulating), the boundary is outcome-dependent and the bounded AUC 0.811 is overfit to the pass set.

vulnerabilities.claim: V22 locked rule represents an immutable, validated frozen baseline that V27/V28 successors failed to beat.
vulnerabilities.weakness: The rule was committed before validation (commit 013639b), and primary locked validation is mixed (1/3 primary pass excluding the exploratory exact UC). 'Tool-robust' in V28 is conditional on the same n=19 bounded set, so robustness tests are non-independent.
vulnerabilities.concrete_test: Quantify effective independence of the V28 robustness tests via a shared-sample variance decomposition: report the fraction of variance in each metric attributable to the same 19 subjects vs methodological choice. Also recompute permutation p with subject-level (not row-level) shuffling stratified by cohort.
vulnerabilities.falsifies_if: If subject-stratified permutation p for bounded AUC exceeds 0.05, or if jackknife-removing the top 2 most influential subjects drops AUC below 0.65, the 'tool-robust' framing overstates evidence.

vulnerabilities.claim: GPR25 is the leading causal gene at MS-UC chr1, with KIF21B as a re-evaluated alternative.
vulnerabilities.weakness: V19 dense QTD000021 coloc gave PP.H4 ~0.87 for KIF21B with 472 aligned SNPs, while GPR25 GTEx evidence rests on 2 lead SNPs and direction was revised in V16. The V15-V19 narrative still leans GPR25-favored despite KIF21B having stronger formal coloc.
vulnerabilities.concrete_test: Run coloc.abf and SuSiE-coloc head-to-head with identical SNP sets and priors for GPR25 (using GTEx whole-blood full sumstats if reachable, or eQTLGen significant proxy with explicit caveat) vs KIF21B QTD000021. Report PP.H4 difference and whether shared credible-set variants pinpoint either gene.
vulnerabilities.falsifies_if: If matched-input coloc gives KIF21B PP.H4 > GPR25 PP.H4 by >0.2, or if shared credible-set variants overlap a KIF21B intronic eQTL but not a GPR25 eQTL, the GPR25-leading framing should be reversed.

vulnerabilities.claim: V26 deep-structure analysis supports a recurrent immune-remodeling/APC axis across modalities.
vulnerabilities.weakness: Only 2 of multiple modality pairings passed (pharmacodynamic-cell_state and cell_state-cross_disease), and these modalities likely share upstream gene-membership construction, inflating cosine similarity. Perturbation Mixscale and response-outcome did not pass, which is inconsistent with a true universal axis.
vulnerabilities.concrete_test: Quantify gene-set overlap between the module definitions used by each passing modality pair. Recompute cosine similarity after removing genes shared across both modalities' module definitions; rerun permutation null with module-construction-aware shuffling.
vulnerabilities.falsifies_if: If shared-gene-removed cosine drops below 0.5 or BH q rises above 0.1 for both passing pairs, the V26 axis is a module-definition artifact rather than a deep biological structure.
